description: On every save of an app file, run the repo check script (JS syntax, no placeholder images, .kiro present) and report failures in the Kiro agent panel instead of silently committing broken work.
name: format-and-link-check-on-save
notes: This hook is documentation + automation for the Kiro workflow: it is the hook Kiro runs when this repo is opened in Kiro IDE with agent hooks enabled.
It does not auto-fix anything. If scripts/check.sh fails, fix the failure by hand and save again.
The check script is intentionally small and dependency-free so it runs the same way in Kiro IDE, in CI, and on the author's machine.
